jobs.title: Business Project Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Business Project Managers
to support cross-functional teams and ensure seamless execution of project workflows using Azure DevOps.
This role is pivotal in driving team alignment, maintaining visibility into progress, and fostering consistent project management practices. The ideal candidate is a natural collaborator with strong communication skills, capable of facilitating stand-ups and meetings, identifying blockers, and keeping stakeholders informed through clear reporting. If you are detail-oriented and passionate about enabling teams to deliver high-quality work on time, we’d love to meet you.

This position is a night shift work-from-home position with a usual schedule of 9am EST - 6pm EST.

Responsibilities
(include but are not limited to the following):
Manage project timelines, deliverables, and department-specific task boards using Azure DevOps
Coordinate tasks and resources across multiple teams to ensure alignment with goals and deadlines
Support development teams by facilitating stand-ups, meetings, and follow-ups
Serve as a key point of contact for internal teams, maintaining smooth communication and progress tracking
Ensure team boards are up to date and clearly reflect current priorities and status
Assist in planning, deployment, and handover of completed work, including documentation and scheduling
Help identify risks, delays, and blockers, and work with leaders to resolve them
Prepare simple reports and updates for management on team/project progress
Champion consistency in work management practices and drive team collaboration
Guide teams in applying basic Agile principles to improve workflow and delivery

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, IT, Legal Studies, or related field—or equivalent experience
Minimum 4 years of experience in project management

Familiarity with project management tools, particularly Azure DevOps
, as well as others like Jira, Trello, or similar task boards
Strong organizational and communication skills with a detail-oriented mindset
Proficient in English (spoken and written) / Very Strong Communication
(American accent is a plus)
Comfortable working full-time on a night shift schedule
Able to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced setting
Knowledge of Agile or Scrum frameworks

Background supporting US-based clients or distributed teams
High Ownership; Cross-functional Technical Fluency; Experience Risk Management Practices and Operating in Fast-Paced Environments

Nice-to-Have:

Previous experience working on a night shift and remote setup
Has experience coordinating and delivering key cross-functional business initiatives at a high-level of impact and ownership
Scrum Master or PMP-related certification/training

jobs.title: Sr Project Manager, Implementations
jobs.description:
Jeppesen ForeFlight is redefining the future of aviation technology, equipping pilots, operators, and decision-makers with the software tools to forge bold new digital paths that push past the expected. We stand with those who dream bigger, fly farther, and seek to explore the next frontier in the cockpit and operations center.

Jeppesen ForeFlight is seeking a Senior Project Manager, Implementations reporting to the Senior Manager, Professional Services Implementation & Deployment, to lead complex, customer-facing implementation and migration projects across our legacy and next-generation flight planning products, including our JetPlan Engine platform migration program moving customers off unsupported legacy hardware and operating systems onto current, supported infrastructure.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will own the end-to-end planning, scheduling, and delivery of multi-workstream implementation and migration projects, coordinating across Development, Deployment Specialists, Quality Assurance, and the customer's own technical team to move complex, production flight-planning systems safely from legacy infrastructure onto our current platforms.

A successful candidate is comfortable being the connective tissue across engineering, deployment, and the customer on a technically complex, high-stakes project, tracking schedule, risk, and dependencies with equal rigor. You're equally comfortable running a detailed cutover plan, presenting a clear status update to executive stakeholders, and keeping several concurrent migrations on track at once. You either know legacy-to-modern infrastructure migrations already, or you're eager to learn the space quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Own project planning, scheduling, and status reporting for one or more complex implementation and migration projects, from kickoff through go-live and into early production support handoff
Build and maintain detailed project plans, RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), and cutover/go-live runbooks for each migration
Coordinate across Development, Deployment Specialists, Quality Assurance, and Support to sequence and de-risk cutover activities for production systems that cannot tolerate extended downtime
Manage and track project status in Salesforce, keeping stakeholders and leadership current on schedule, risk, and blockers
Lead recurring customer- and internal-facing status meetings, translating technical migration details into clear, actionable updates for both technical and executive stakeholders
Coordinate go-live/cutover events directly with customer technical teams, including scheduling maintenance windows and validating post-cutover system health
Identify and escalate schedule, resource, or technical risks early, and drive mitigation plans to closure
Support post-go-live stabilization and a clean handoff to ongoing support
Partner with Product, Support, and other internal teams to resolve issues and escalations surfaced during a migration
Travel to customer sites on occasion, as needed

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of project management experience delivering complex, technical implementation or migration projects, ideally including production system cutovers
Experience managing multi-stakeholder projects spanning internal engineering/deployment teams and external customer technical teams
Strong technical aptitude, comfortable understanding infrastructure migration concepts (e.g., legacy operating system to Linux platform migrations) well enough to plan and sequence around them, without requiring a software engineering background
Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM/project-tracking tool
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting project status to both technical teams and executive stakeholders
Strong critical thinking and risk-management skills, with the ability to identify and mitigate schedule and technical risk before it becomes a problem
Willingness to learn and apply AI-powered tools to accelerate project tracking, status reporting, and cross-team coordination; prior hands-on experience with AI tools is a plus
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize independently

Preferred Qualifications

PMP or a comparable project management certification
Experience in airline operations, flight dispatch, or aviation technology
Experience coordinating international, multi-time-zone customer implementations
Background in client or account management, with the ability to translate customer needs into a project plan
Comfort working across time zones with international customers

About Jeppesen ForeFlight

Jeppesen ForeFlight is a leading provider of innovative aviation software solutions, serving the Commercial, Business, Military, and General Aviation sectors globally. Combining Jeppesen’s 90-year legacy of accurate aeronautical data with ForeFlight’s expertise in cutting-edge aviation technology, the company delivers an integrated suite of tools designed to enhance safety, improve operational efficiency, and sharpen decision-making.

Why You Should Join

At Jeppesen ForeFlight, we know you want a rewarding career. To do that, you need challenging projects, a good work environment, and awesome coworkers. We believe in our employees, and we empower them to make a direct impact on our products and services messaging. We strive to provide our team and their loved ones with a world-class benefits experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Our benefits package includes but not limited to the following:

Medical, dental, vision insurance with Employer paid health premiums
Open PTO Policy
401(k) with up to 10% company matching and immediate vesting
12 Weeks Paid Maternity Leave
12 Weeks Paid Paternity Leave
Flight Training Rewards

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well market and business considerations: Summary Pay Range: $122,000-$150,000

jobs.title: Project Manager - Data Center Delivery
jobs.description:
About QC Servion

QC Servion is the centralized hub for human resources, change management, program management, sales & marketing, safety, administration, legal, and accounting services across the QC Ecosystem.

We provide comprehensive operational support that empowers our companies to focus on growth, innovation, and excellence, while ensuring employees thrive in safe, engaging, and well-managed environments.

The entities in our ecosystem include DLB Associates, Galtra Solutions, AI2IO, Fluid2Chip, CEQEL Critical Commissioning, and 2AI-DC Integrators. Collectively, we deliver services across the data center industry.

Position:

Project Manager

Position Location:

Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Salary

QC Servion recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

QC Servion is seeking a Project Manager to support large-scale infrastructure and data center programs across the QC Ecosystem. This role is responsible for owning individual projects and workstreams from kickoff through closeout while ensuring alignment with broader program objectives, schedules, and stakeholder expectations.

We are looking for a project leader with experience supporting engineering, construction, infrastructure, capital projects, data centers, or EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) environments.

The Project Manager will work closely with Program Managers, Project Controls, engineering teams, design partners, contractors, vendors, and ecosystem stakeholders to drive execution, maintain visibility into project performance, and proactively resolve issues before they impact delivery.

Essential Functions

Project Leadership & Execution

Own assigned projects and workstreams from initiation through closeout.
Develop and maintain project execution plans, schedules, and milestone tracking.
Drive project progress and accountability across internal teams, vendors, consultants, and external partners.
Coordinate project activities to ensure alignment with program objectives, timelines, and deliverables.
Facilitate project meetings, track action items, and follow through to completion.

Schedule & Program Integration

Build and maintain project-level schedules aligned to the broader program master schedule.
Monitor project dependencies and identify impacts to adjacent workstreams.
Support integration of project schedules into the overall program plan.
Escalate schedule risks and conflicts proactively while recommending mitigation strategies.

Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination

Coordinate activities across engineering, design, construction, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders.
Manage communication between project teams, vendors, consultants, and leadership.
Ensure all parties understand scope, responsibilities, milestones, and expectations.
Support cross-functional collaboration across the QC Ecosystem and external delivery partners.

Project Controls & Reporting

Track project budgets, scope, schedules, risks, issues, and progress.
Maintain accurate project documentation including meeting notes, decision logs, change requests, and status reports.
Provide regular project updates and executive-ready reporting to Program Leadership.
Contribute to phase-gate reviews and readiness assessments.

Risk Management & Problem Solving

Identify project-level risks, constraints, and issues early.
Drive resolution through collaboration and ownership.
Develop mitigation plans and corrective actions when needed.
Escalate issues appropriately while ensuring accountability remains clear.

What Success Looks Like

Projects remain aligned with program milestones and strategic objectives.
Risks and issues are identified and resolved before impacting delivery.
Stakeholders have clear visibility into project status, priorities, and next steps.
Documentation and reporting are accurate, current, and decision-ready.
Engineering, design, vendors, and project teams remain coordinated and accountable.
Workstreams are delivered on schedule, within scope, and with minimal leadership intervention.

Position Requirements

Bachelor's degree preferred; PMP or similar credential a plus.
3–6+ years of Project Management experience supporting infrastructure, construction, engineering, capital projects, utilities, manufacturing, data centers, or EPC environments.
Demonstrated ability to independently manage a defined scope of work from start to finish.
Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, vendors, consultants, and technical teams.
Strong understanding of project scheduling, dependencies, risk management, and project execution.
Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience maintaining project documentation and status reporting.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

Data center development, construction, commissioning, or infrastructure experience.
Experience within EPC, engineering consulting, owner’s representative, or capital project delivery environments.
Exposure to large-scale infrastructure, mission-critical facilities, energy, utility, or industrial projects.
Experience supporting multiple projects within a larger program structure.
PMP or similar project management certification.

Physical Demands

Duties

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

Frequently required to remain in a stationary position.
Frequently moving through home office.
May occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

Travel Requirements

Up to 20%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.
Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Benefits

Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option).
Flex spending accounts (FSA).
Dental and vision plans.
Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26.
401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option.
PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year.
Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage.
Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and professional licensing assistance.
Paid parental leave after one year of employment.

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is QC Servion's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

EEO

QC Servion provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Notice To Third Party Agencies

Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to QC Servion in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where QC Servion has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking a Long Haul Fiber Test & Acceptance Project Manager
to manage and coordinate Zayo's long haul OSP deployment in order to meet customer expectations and Zayo standards. Our Long Haul Fiber Test & Acceptance Project Manager
will ensure consistency and budget alignments.

Responsibilities:

Responsible for daily management of OSP vendors to expedite the splicing and testing of fiber optic OSP facilities.
Mandatory on call duty to respond to network outages and emergency restoration activities on a weekly rotation with other OSP PMs.
Coordinate access to customer and network points of presence for fiber splicing and testing vendors.
Assist in the planning and implementation of fiber connectivity solutions programs and projects that adhere to approved plans, budgets and schedules.
Provide specialized telecommunications technical expertise.
Coordinate and facilitate with internal and external resources to effect the timely completion of projects.
Oversee product and/or service of the unit(s) managed may involve highly technical activities or programs; or policies, procedures, controls and services required to support the sound financial, operational and competitive position of the company.
Implement commercial and carrier fiber networks, infrastructure, backbone and lateral builds.
Work within a Data Center environment implementing customer-installation projects and services.
Oversee vendor compliance with OSP deliverables.
Create and track project budgets in relationship to Network Operations.
Provide direct interface with customers, subcontractors, jurisdictional authorities and interoffice personnel. Support customer meetings as necessary which requires in person meetings and travel to client and/or construction sites.
Oversee procurement of equipment and materials related to the assigned projects.
Execute Bid Process, inclusive of budgetary requirements and the tracking thereof.
Verify and update project documentation.
Timely tracking of project progress and budget in Salesforce and manual tracker.
Timely update of budget requests, purchase orders, project close out and internal service orders in Salesforce.

Qualifications:

Bachelors’ Degree, preferred.
Minimum of five (5) years in the telecommunications industry with outside plant, fiber optics, telecommunication architectures, optical transport equipment, and project management experience.
Minimum of three (3) years of familiarity with all types of outside plant construction and experience managing large capital projects.
Fiber optic cable splicing and testing knowledge not required but preference will be given to candidates with this experience.
Familiar with Email, MS Excel, Word, Google Earth and AutoCad.
Ability to manage multiple aggressive RFP and design construction schedules and responses.
Ability to understand and read construction and fiber splicing documents.
Familiarity with all facets of OSP management, including quoting, construction, troubleshooting and delivery.
Possess a valid driver’s license with the ability to drive as required to his/her assigned projects in order to ensure on time and on budget delivery.
Ability to perform on-site surveys and attend required field meetings to ensure projects meet the delivery/ commitment dates identified.
Ability to occasionally to meet with various municipalities and vendors to review project scope and to ensure positive communication is maintained.
Mandatory on call duty will be assigned on a weekly rotation with other OSP Project Managers.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Total Rewards
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We're a small, high-leverage team that bridges strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

What you’ll do

Stripe's Total Rewards programs span compensation, benefits, equity, internal mobility/immigration, and mergers and acquisitions (M&A), each with cross-functional dependencies, regulatory stakes, and direct impact on the Stripes they affect. Delivering these programs well takes a Project Manager who develops real subject matter depth, engages with pillar leads as a strategic partner, and brings structure to decisions that aren't always clear-cut.

We're hiring a Project Manager to own high-priority Total Rewards projects and programs end to end. You'll work closely with our Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A pillars, building expertise in how these programs work and what it takes to land them well. Some programs have established playbooks you'll sharpen; others are less defined and will need you to help shape the approach before you execute it. Across all of them, you'll identify dependencies early, proactively surface and mitigate risks, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving toward clear outcomes. This is a high-leverage individual contributor role for someone who brings both rigor and judgment to every project they own.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end project management for high-profile cyclical and transformational Total Rewards projects, from intake and scoping through go-live and handoff to program owners
Advise and embed with project teams across the Total Rewards and People portfolio, raising the quality bar and building PM capability across the extended team, not just doing the work yourself
Build subject matter expertise across Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A — becoming a reliable strategic thought partner to pillar teams on program decisions, not just a tracker of status
Build, automate, and continuously improve the infrastructure that makes program management repeatable and scalable: intake frameworks, project plan templates, SOPs, playbooks, and handoff checklists for common program types
Leverage AI tools in your daily work and the team's workflows, using them to accelerate synthesis, drafting, stakeholder communications, and documentation, and actively identifying new opportunities to work faster and better
Drive cross-functional alignment across People and key partner functions (Legal, Finance, Corporate Technology, and others), creating shared visibility into priorities, dependencies, and blockers
Tackle complex, ambiguous program questions with rigor and independence, owning work from problem definition through final recommendation — including defining the approach, monitoring progress, identifying risks early, and putting mitigation in place before issues land
Surface patterns and gaps across the program portfolio, translating observations into structured analysis and recommendations for People leadership

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of People project, program, or operations management experience, including at least 3 years driving multi-stakeholder, cross-functional programs end to end, ideally at a scaling or global company
A track record of building from scratch: you've created processes, playbooks, or program infrastructure where none existed before, not just improved what was already in place
Excellent written communication: you can produce an executive update, a stakeholder decision memo, and a practitioner playbook with equal fluency
Strong stakeholder management across senior cross-functional partners: you drive results with a balance of urgency and thoughtfulness, and know when to push, when to align, and when to escalate
AI expertise: you default to AI tools for synthesis, drafting, analysis, and communications, and you proactively design workflows that help the team move faster and operate at scale.
Analytical fluency: you can work with data to build a credible narrative, identify patterns across a program portfolio, and make recommendations grounded in evidence
A users-first mindset: you obsess over the Stripe employee experience and the operator experience, not just the project/program artifacts

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with change management frameworks (such as Prosci ADKAR) and judgment about when to apply structured change management vs. lighter-touch approaches
Experience building and deploying enablement materials or training resources for cross-functional teams
Experience in Total Rewards, People Operations, or an adjacent HR domain
Familiarity with PM and collaboration tools (Asana, Jira, or similar)
Familiarity with Total Rewards or HR systems (such as Workday, equity administration platforms, or benefits administration tools)
PMP, Lean/Six Sigma, or comparable structured-program training

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

We're a small, high-leverage team that bridges strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

What you’ll do

Stripe's Total Rewards programs span compensation, benefits, equity, internal mobility/immigration, and mergers and acquisitions (M&A), each with cross-functional dependencies, regulatory stakes, and direct impact on the Stripes they affect. Delivering these programs well takes a Project Manager who develops real subject matter depth, engages with pillar leads as a strategic partner, and brings structure to decisions that aren't always clear-cut.

We're hiring a Project Manager to own high-priority Total Rewards projects and programs end to end. You'll work closely with our Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A pillars, building expertise in how these programs work and what it takes to land them well. Some programs have established playbooks you'll sharpen; others are less defined and will need you to help shape the approach before you execute it. Across all of them, you'll identify dependencies early, proactively surface and mitigate risks, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving toward clear outcomes. This is a high-leverage individual contributor role for someone who brings both rigor and judgment to every project they own.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end project management for high-profile cyclical and transformational Total Rewards projects, from intake and scoping through go-live and handoff to program owners
Advise and embed with project teams across the Total Rewards and People portfolio, raising the quality bar and building PM capability across the extended team, not just doing the work yourself
Build subject matter expertise across Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A — becoming a reliable strategic thought partner to pillar teams on program decisions, not just a tracker of status
Build, automate, and continuously improve the infrastructure that makes program management repeatable and scalable: intake frameworks, project plan templates, SOPs, playbooks, and handoff checklists for common program types
Leverage AI tools in your daily work and the team's workflows, using them to accelerate synthesis, drafting, stakeholder communications, and documentation, and actively identifying new opportunities to work faster and better
Drive cross-functional alignment across People and key partner functions (Legal, Finance, Corporate Technology, and others), creating shared visibility into priorities, dependencies, and blockers
Tackle complex, ambiguous program questions with rigor and independence, owning work from problem definition through final recommendation — including defining the approach, monitoring progress, identifying risks early, and putting mitigation in place before issues land
Surface patterns and gaps across the program portfolio, translating observations into structured analysis and recommendations for People leadership

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of People project, program, or operations management experience, including at least 3 years driving multi-stakeholder, cross-functional programs end to end, ideally at a scaling or global company
A track record of building from scratch: you've created processes, playbooks, or program infrastructure where none existed before, not just improved what was already in place
Excellent written communication: you can produce an executive update, a stakeholder decision memo, and a practitioner playbook with equal fluency
Strong stakeholder management across senior cross-functional partners: you drive results with a balance of urgency and thoughtfulness, and know when to push, when to align, and when to escalate
AI expertise: you default to AI tools for synthesis, drafting, analysis, and communications, and you proactively design workflows that help the team move faster and operate at scale.
Analytical fluency: you can work with data to build a credible narrative, identify patterns across a program portfolio, and make recommendations grounded in evidence
A users-first mindset: you obsess over the Stripe employee experience and the operator experience, not just the project/program artifacts

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with change management frameworks (such as Prosci ADKAR) and judgment about when to apply structured change management vs. lighter-touch approaches
Experience building and deploying enablement materials or training resources for cross-functional teams
Experience in Total Rewards, People Operations, or an adjacent HR domain
Familiarity with PM and collaboration tools (Asana, Jira, or similar)
Familiarity with Total Rewards or HR systems (such as Workday, equity administration platforms, or benefits administration tools)
PMP, Lean/Six Sigma, or comparable structured-program training

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
As a founding member of our rapidly evolving Project Management team, you will provide end-to-end ownership of complex, high-impact new product development (NPD) programs. You will lead multiple cross-functional teams through the NPD process from concept to retail launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on cost, and on spec.

Because our PMO is a newly established function, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our operational standards, creating deep and meaningful partnerships companywide, and demonstrating project management’s strategic value. You serve as a strategic partner, facilitator, and escalation point—driving alignment at leadership levels, navigating high ambiguity, and setting the standard for execution excellence.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities are executed in alignment with PMO standards, methodologies, and the Project Management Competency Matrix. Duties include but are not limited to:

Project & Timeline Management: Own and drive multiple large or complex NPD programs simultaneously through the Phase Gate process. Develop and manage integrated timelines, anticipate delivery risks, and lead cross‑functional teams through trade‑off decisions to protect timing, cost, and scope. This is a leadership role focused on ownership and outcomes, not task execution for other functions. Actively help define and refine our NPD gates and milestones as our PMO matures.
Product & Cross‑Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product Managers, Marketing, R&D, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and Creative at both working and leadership levels. Facilitate high‑impact meetings, drive decision‑making, and ensure alignment on priorities, commitments, and deliverables across functions.
Advanced Risk Management: Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks across programs with significant business impact. Develop mitigation and contingency plans, escalate appropriately, and prevent late‑stage surprises through early visibility and action.
Stakeholder Communication: Provide clear, concise, and strategic project updates to cross‑functional leaders and stakeholders. Influence alignment and decision‑making by clearly communicating risks, trade‑offs, and recommendations.
Continuous Improvement: Lead efforts to strengthen PMO processes, tools, and standards. Identify systemic gaps across teams and drive improvements that enable more predictable, efficient, and scalable product launches. Help design, pilot, and champion new PMO tools, templates, and communication cadences that make the team more efficient.

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree required (Business, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, or similar).
Typically 7–10+ years of professional experience, including extensive ownership of complex NPD programs.

Technical Skills

Expert proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools.

Management Skills

Detail‑Oriented: Manages complex, interdependent project details across multiple programs, anticipating downstream impacts to scope, timing, cost, and quality. Identifies patterns and systemic risks early to prevent escalation and late‑stage disruption.
Communication: Provides clear, concise, and strategic verbal and written communication across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership. Translates complex project dynamics into decision‑ready insights that drive alignment and action.
Problem‑Solving: Anticipates obstacles before they emerge, quickly assesses root causes, and guides teams toward practical, durable solutions that balance business priorities and execution realities.
Cross‑Functional Fluency: Demonstrates deep fluency across Brand, Engineering, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, and other partner functions. Uses this understanding to drive effective collaboration, sound trade‑offs, and strong execution outcomes.
Adaptability & Ambiguity: Thrives in high‑pressure, fast‑changing environments with competing priorities. Leads teams confidently through ambiguity, maintaining momentum and focus despite shifting inputs or incomplete information.

Interpersonal Skills

Mediator, not Participant: Leads as an objective, unbiased truth teller who balances competing functional priorities and interests. Facilitates tough conversations, surfaces hard truths early, and drives fair, informed outcomes aligned to overall business goals.
Conflict Navigation: Navigates complex, high‑stakes conflicts across teams and leadership levels with sound judgment. Resolves competing priorities constructively, escalating appropriately to protect project outcomes.
Calm in the Storm: Maintains composure, clarity, and decisiveness during periods of significant pressure or uncertainty. Sets the tone for teams, helping others remain focused and productive during tight deadlines or critical moments.
Influence Without Authority: Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across the organization and influences outcomes through credibility and expertise. Effectively drives commitment, accountability, and follow‑through without relying on formal authority.
Attention to Detail: Continuously monitors program health at both project and portfolio levels, ensuring small gaps or inconsistencies are identified early and do not scale into larger delivery or quality issues.

Pay And Benefits

US$130,000.00 - US$140,000.00 Annually

Final compensation offered will be determined based on a number of job-related factors, including the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications. Employees in this role are eligible to participate in the company’s benefits program, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company matching, accrued vacation, floating holidays, and designated company holidays.

Offer contingent on successful completion of a background check.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager
, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.
Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.
Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.
Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.
Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.
Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.
Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.
Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.
Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.
Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.
Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.
Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.
Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.
Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.
Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.
Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.
Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.
Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.
Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.
Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.
Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.
Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.
Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.
Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.
Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.
Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.
Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.
Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.
Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.
Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation?
Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.description:
Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Start here. Grow here.

We are proud to have been appointed to all three Flood Risk and Asset Management (FRAM) Lots, the first to be announced under the UK Government Commercial Agency
’s Construction Professional Services 2 (CPS2) Framework.

The award deepens our 25-year partnership with the Environment Agency
, through delivering our expert technical, environmental, and commercial and programme services across flood and coastal risk management.

We will support the Environment Agency in ensuring the safe and efficient delivery of their record investment programme, reducing flood risk, and delivering projects that protect communities and benefit the environment.

We are seeking Project Managers, with a history of delivering in the Water industry to join our Infrastructure Project Management team to work on the FRAM across our North, Midlands and Scotland Region operating from 8 regional offices.

Our growth trajectory is strong, supported by a robust pipeline of projects and you will be joining a growing team of like-minded people that have a passion for innovation and delivering cutting edge solutions.

As Project Manager, you will be expected to work with a Senior Project Manager / Associate to successfully manage, coordinate and deliver -water projects.

The role will cover the whole project lifecycle from initial inception, through the design, procurement process and onto the site delivery and commissioning phases.

Here’s what you’ll do

As Project Manager, you will be expected to work as part of or lead a team to successfully manage and deliver capital investment projects. This role involves providing client-side project management support during all stages of the project delivery lifecycle from option studies, option development, and construction tender support through to NEC contract administration and on-site delivery.
Support Project Management commissions, taking responsibility for their successful delivery.
Participation in appropriate meetings including minuting and proactively engaging in discussions, contributing to the PEP, collating progress reports, assisting with procurement strategies and tender documentation, general post contract management and administration
Proactively engaging with Client, contractor and other stakeholders, being aware of the scope of service and ensuring we deliver within the agreed parameters and help to resolve disputes whenever possible.
Client-side project management, including stakeholder, H&S, risk, quality, schedule, and contract management
Support projects and commissions are delivered to the satisfaction of the client for quality, cost, and time
Support and manage the project team ensuring appropriate resources are provided on projects, meeting the client and business requirements
Manage the delivery of project management team outputs, in accordance with agreed timescales and quality standards.
Develop strong relationships with clients and members of the cross-functional team
Support business development opportunities with existing and new clients
Provide support on contract management services on NEC4 contracts, administering through a contract management system.
Advise the client on procurement strategies and review tender documentation.
Provide effective support and mentoring to Graduates and Apprentices.

If you're passionate about innovation and turning bold ideas into reality, AECOM welcomes you. Join our team, where we don't just construct infrastructure but also uplift communities and enhance lives. Why not give our AECOM page on LinkedIn a follow to stay updated on the impactful projects we're working on and see firsthand the difference we're making in the industry!

Qualifications

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Here’s what we’re looking for:

Infrastructure project management experience (Water industry experience essential)
Knowledge and understanding of NEC suite of contracts, particularly the Professional Services Contract (PSC) and Engineering and Construction Contract (ECC) ideally working towards NEC ECC Accreditation
Experience of working as part of an integrated, multi-organisation, collaborative teams
Good communication and organisational skills
Relationship building skills –ability to build strong relationships with clients, teams, and stakeholders as well as an ability to build and maintain networks of business contacts.
Able to work under own initiative where appropriate working closely with the Senior Project Managers and Associates in the delivery of some of our projects.
A team player with a ‘can-do’ attitude, outgoing, polite, patient, diplomatic, personable, respectful, and flexible
Excellent IT Skills and the ability to utilize current digital tools.
Excellent numeracy, verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to manage relationships both internally and externally.
Keen to work as part of a team and to develop and progress career development.
Engenders a right first-time approach.
Supporter of social and CSR activities, promoting a positive and enjoyable workplace.

Education, Professional Qualifications Requirements

The individuals proposed for the role will ideally demonstrate the following:

A minimum 2 to 4 years of proven experience in a consulting environment providing a full spectrum of PM services including chairing meetings, minuting or proactively engaging in discussions, developing the PEP, progress reports, and tender documentation. General post contract management and administration, proactively engaging with relevant stakeholders, being aware of the scope of service and ensuring we deliver within the agreed parameters.
A relevant degree such as in project management, engineering, environmental science, construction, or relevant subject.
Understanding and use of NEC suite of contracts, particularly the Professional Services Contract (PSC) and Engineering and Construction Contract (ECC)
A project management qualification such as the APM PMQ or PRINCE2 would be desirable.
An associate member of a related professional body preferably chartered (APM, CIOB) would be desirable.
You may be required to undertake and successfully complete security screening checks.

Additional Information

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Our teams are driven by a common purpose to deliver a better world through our unrivaled technical and digital expertise, a culture of equity, diversity and inclusion, and a commitment to environmental, social and governance priorities. AECOM provides a wide array of compensation, benefits and well-being programs to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. We’re the world’s trusted global infrastructure firm, and we’re in this together – your growth and success are ours too.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager
, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.
Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.
Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.
Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.
Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.
Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.
Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.
Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.
Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.
Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.
Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.
Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.
Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.
Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.
Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.
Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.
Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.
Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.
Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.
Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.
Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.
Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.
Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.
Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.
Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.
Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.
Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.
Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.
Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.
Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation?
Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.description:
Position Title

Agile Project Manager / Release Train Engineer (T & I) (Telework/Hybrid)

Status Of Employment

Permanent

Position Language Requirement

English, French

Language Skills

English (Reading - C - Advanced), English (Speaking - C - Advanced), English (Writing - B - Intermediate), French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - C - Advanced), French (Writing - B - Intermediate)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date

2026-10-30 11:59 PM

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your role

As a Senior Agile Project Manager / Release Train Engineer (APM/RTE) within the T&I Value Management and Delivery Office, you serve as a program-level orchestrator and pivotal bridge between agile product delivery and traditional enterprise governance. Assigned to a high-impact product family, you will operate within a SAFe-inspired agile bubble; while navigating fixed financial, legal, and operational parameters of a public broadcasting environment.

This is an intensive matrix leadership position. You will work across multiple teams, departments, and corporate functions where you do not possess direct line-management or hierarchical organizational authority. Success requires exceptional lateral leadership, emotional intelligence, and the ability to influence peers, product leaders, corporate partners, and external technology vendors toward shared program outcomes.

Foundational Leadership Competencies

Beyond technical agile process knowledge, you possess foundational capabilities that enable effective execution in a complex matrix enterprise:

Influencing Without Authority & Lateral Leadership: proven ability to align cross-functional peers, Product Owners, Solution Architects, and non-agile business partners behind program objectives without formal line-management authority. Mastery in negotiation, active listening, and building voluntary consensus across matrixed boundaries.
Emotional Intelligence (EQ) & Political Acumen: high self-awareness, diplomacy, and emotional control when navigating political dynamics, competing stakeholder priorities, or resistance to change. Ability to de-escalate friction calmly and turn interpersonal misalignment into constructive problem-solving.
Trust-Building & Program Evangelism: ability to act as an energetic cheerleader and trusted advisor who builds psychological safety and enthusiasm within delivery teams, while simultaneously instilling confidence, credibility, and rigor among executive sponsors and traditional corporate functions.
Resilience & Comfort with Ambiguity: high tolerance for ambiguity, fluid priorities, and non-standard operating environments. Ability to remain composed under pressure, balancing the discipline of traditional corporate controls with the responsiveness of agile delivery.
Pragmatic Tailoring & Systems Thinking: pragmatic, flexible and solution-oriented mindset that balances adherence to core frameworks with fit-for-purpose execution. Able to tailor day-to-day practices and propose refinements while adhering to core structures to drive business value.
Presentation Skills & Audience Adaptability: highly comfortable and effective presenting in English and in French to varying audiences, including key business partners, at different levels, tailoring messaging and presentation to the audience and objectives.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

Scaled Agile Cadence & Program-Level Orchestration: Lead and facilitate core program-level ceremonies, including Pre-Quarterly Alignment, Quarterly Alignment (PI Planning equivalent), Program Demos (including major vendor demos like Dalet), Program Syncs, Orchestration Syncs, and Product Discovery & Architecture Syncs.
Dependency, Risk & Impediment Resolution: Identify, map, and resolve cross-team dependencies and systemic program impediments alongside Scrum Masters, while maintaining an active program risk register with strategic escalation paths.
Strategic Alignment & Governance Compliance: Ensure product family backlogs and quarterly objectives remain strictly aligned with Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) strategic goals and corporate governance standards.
Tooling Infrastructure & Delivery Visibility: Oversee and maintain program-level Jira and Confluence workspace structures to ensure full delivery transparency across backlogs, epics, and features.
Financial Stewardship & Budget Oversight: Maintain financial guardrails, including financial updates in partnership with Product Directors and POs to satisfy corporate finance requirements.
Operational Model Execution: Partner with the Transformation Lead to operationalize, run, and sustain the scaled agile delivery cadence across all product family teams.
Change Mobilization & Bilingual Enablement: Support cross-departmental change mobilization while enabling seamless bilingual (English/French) communication across distributed product hubs in Montreal and Toronto.
Vendor & Partner Governance: Co-manage strategic software supplier delivery alongside Product leadership, aligning vendor specifications, contractual milestones, and delivery cadences with internal backlogs & roadmaps.
Performance Metrics & Value Realization: Develop and maintain dashboards to track flow metrics, delivery velocity, and business value realization to drive continuous program improvement.
Agile Culture & Bureaucracy Reduction: Embody a servant-leadership posture ('Facilitator vs. Controller'), fostering transparency, team autonomy, and the principle that 'People own the process' while actively streamlining administrative overhead.
Multi-Tier Reporting Cadences: Drive structured reporting across four executive cadences: Weekly operational updates, Bi-weekly leadership syncs, Monthly performance reviews, and Quarterly reporting to Governance Committees and the Board of Directors.

We Are Looking For a Candidate With The Following

Professional Experience: 7+ years of experience in project/program delivery, with at least 3 years in a Senior Agile, Scaled Agile (RTE or equivalent), or Hybrid leadership role managing complex, multi-team initiatives.
Scaled Agile Facilitation: experience facilitating PI Planning / Quarterly Alignment, multi-team demos, and Program Syncs within SAFe or hybrid scaled agile delivery environments.
Vendor Governance: Proven success co-managing strategic third-party vendor contracts, integration milestones, and delivery cadences.
Financial & Governance: Experience interfacing with corporate Finance and Executive Governance, translating agile delivery metrics into traditional financial and risk reports.
Tooling Expertise: proficiency in Jira, Confluence, Power BI, Google Suite is a Strong Asset
Linguistic: bilingual (English/French).
Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience and training.

Some travel may be required.

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:

A mandatory Criminal record check.

or Manager for the IT Program Management Office

jobs.description:

Department: Cancer Center

Working Title: Centers of Excellence Program Manager
