We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM Canadian manufacturing facilities and global headquarters are located in Bolton, Ontario on a large, beautiful campus located just 20 minutes north of Toronto’s Pearson International Airport. Features include a fitness and wellness center, intramural sports activities, on-site cafeteria, and clean, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment and competitive total compensation package, including above market retirement savings plan and market competitive group benefits.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Salary Range: 110k-142k

Replacement

The Global Trade Compliance team operates across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC regions in close collaboration with Husky’s Legal department. The team defines, implements, and continuously improves processes and policies to ensure compliance with global export control, sanctions, and customs regulations.

As the Global Trade Compliance Program Manager, you will report to the Director, Global Trade Compliance & Customs and serve as the program lead for enterprise-wide trade compliance initiatives. This role will focus on managing global compliance projects, optimizing processes, and ensuring the successful integration of trade compliance requirements into Husky’s systems.

You will partner with cross-functional teams—including Supply Chain, Engineering, IT, Finance, and Sales—to strengthen Husky’s global trade compliance framework, enhance operational efficiency, and reduce compliance risk across all regions.

Key Responsibilities

Program and Project Management

Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of global trade compliance initiatives, including process optimization, technology integration, and system enhancements.
Manage the implementation of trade compliance modules within the ERP system to ensure alignment with global regulatory requirements.
Establish and maintain project governance, milestones, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms for trade compliance programs.
Coordinate global stakeholders to ensure timely completion of key deliverables and consistent global deployment of compliance practices.

Regulatory Compliance and Oversight

Stay current on international trade laws, import regulations/tariffs, export control regulations, and sanctions programs applicable to Husky’s business activities.
Translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable business processes and internal controls.
Collaborate with Engineering and Legal teams to establish export control measures and export authorization processes globally.
Monitor the effectiveness of trade compliance procedures and implement corrective actions as needed.

Classification, Licensing, and Documentation

Lead efforts to standardize global product classification processes, including export control, HTS, and country-of-origin determinations.
Develop and maintain processes for end-use/end-user certifications, license applications, and transaction due diligence.
Ensure accuracy and consistency in trade data, documentation, and system configurations supporting export and customs compliance.

Risk Management and Continuous Improvement

Conduct global risk assessments and audits to evaluate compliance performance and identify improvement opportunities.
Develop risk mitigation strategies to prevent export control or import customs violations.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging digital tools and automation to enhance compliance monitoring and reporting.
Support internal investigations and voluntary disclosures, when applicable.

Training, Communication, and Stakeholder Engagement

Develop and deliver global training programs to increase awareness of export control, sanctions, and customs requirements.
Promote a culture of compliance through proactive communication and cross-functional collaboration.
Partner with IT, Supply Chain, and Finance to ensure trade compliance considerations are embedded in business processes.
Provide input in communications with government authorities and external consultants regarding trade compliance projects and inquiries.

Required Experience & Education

10+ years of progressive experience in global trade compliance, covering export controls, customs, sanctions, and trade agreements.
Deep understanding of U.S., EU, and Canadian export control and sanctions laws, with additional experience in UK, Swiss, Chinese, and other jurisdictions considered an asset.
Proven track record in managing large-scale trade compliance or ERP integration projects within a multinational organization.
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, International Business, Law, Supply Chain, or related discipline; PMP or other project management certification preferred.
Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to interpret complex regulations and translate them into practical business solutions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of influencing and engaging stakeholders across multiple levels and functions.
Demonstrated ability to lead change, manage competing priorities, and deliver results under tight deadlines in a global environment.

jobs.title: Distribution Center Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Posting:

Since 1953, Ferguson has been a source of quality supplies for a variety of industries. Together We Build Better infrastructure, better homes and better businesses. We exist to make our customers’ complex projects simple, successful, and sustainable. We proactively solve problems, adapt and grow to continuously serve our customers, communities and each other. Ferguson, a Fortune 500 company, is proud to provide best-in-class products, service and capabilities across the following industries: Commercial/Mechanical, Facilities Supply, Fire and Fabrication, HVAC, Industrial, Residential Trade, Residential Building and Remodel, Waterworks and Residential Digital Commerce. Ferguson has approximately 36,000 associates across 1,700 locations. Ferguson is a community of proud associates who operate with the shared purpose of building something meaningful. You will build a career that you are proud of, at a company you can believe in.

Ferguson is seeking an Operations Analyst
to join our team at the Bloomingdale Distribution Center
! In this role, you'll combine data analytics expertise with a strong understanding of warehouse and distribution operations to drive performance improvements across our distribution center. Partnering closely with operations leadership and frontline teams, you'll analyze warehouse processes, labor efficiency, inventory flow, and operational performance to find opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and implement data-driven solutions.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys being both on the warehouse floor and behind the data, using operational knowledge and analytical insights to improve efficiency, productivity, and customer service. You'll play a critical role in helping the distribution center optimize operations, improve performance visibility, and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Schedule:

This role is onsite and works a mid-shift schedule of 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, with flexibility to adjust hours based on business needs.

What You'll Do:

Partner with distribution center leadership to analyze warehouse operations, labor productivity, inventory flow, and overall supply chain performance.
Develop, maintain, and enhance operational reports, dashboards, and KPIs that support distribution center decision-making.
Gain a deep understanding of warehouse processes, including receiving, put-away, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, and inventory control.
Analyze Warehouse Management System (WMS) and Labor Management System (LMS) data to identify trends, operational bottlenecks, process variances, and improvement opportunities.
Transform complex operational and supply chain data into clear, actionable recommendations that support business decisions.
Produce and present weekly operational performance metrics and insights to Supply Chain Leadership.
Build and complete ad hoc SQL queries to support operational analysis, reporting, and central initiatives.
Collaborate with operations, inventory, transportation, and supply chain teams to improve processes, reporting accuracy, and performance visibility.
Design and maintain Power BI dashboards that provide meaningful insight into warehouse productivity, labor utilization, inventory movement, and service-level performance.
Support training initiatives through documentation development, training delivery, and implementation of operational guidelines.
Manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced distribution environment.
Lead ongoing improvement efforts that improve warehouse efficiency, labor performance, inventory accuracy, and customer service.

What You'll Bring:

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
3-5 years of experience supporting warehouse, distribution center, logistics, or supply chain operations in an analytical capacity.
Strong working knowledge of distribution center operations, including receiving, inventory management, replenishment, order fulfillment, shipping, and labor productivity.
Experience analyzing operational performance and identifying process improvement opportunities within a warehouse, fulfillment, manufacturing, or logistics environment.
Hands-on experience supporting or working within a warehouse, distribution center, fulfillment center, or logistics operation strongly preferred.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities within large datasets.
Experience with data mining, reporting, KPI development, and operational performance analysis.
Experience working with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and labor management or productivity measurement tools preferred.
Proficiency in SQL, Microsoft Access, and Excel.
Experience creating and maintaining dashboards in Power BI.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills coupled with the capacity to influence collaborators at all levels of the organization.
Ability to translate operational challenges into data-driven solutions and business recommendations.
Strong organizational skills and success in managing multiple projects simultaneously.

Why Join Ferguson?

At Ferguson, you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on distribution center performance by combining operational knowledge with analytics. You'll work alongside experienced supply chain and operations leaders. You will gain exposure to large-scale distribution processes. You will help build solutions that improve efficiency, output, and customer happiness across our network.

At Ferguson, we care for each other. We value our well-being just as much as our hard work. We are committed to a holistic approach towards benefits plans and programs that support the mental, physical and financial well-being of our associates. jobs.title: Business Analyst, Innovation lab
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon's operations network (Fulfilment Centres, Sort Centres, IXDs, Return Centres, Last Mile Stations, Quick Commerce hubs and Micro Fulfilment Centres) is the physical engine at the heart of Amazon. It moves billions of units of inventory, employs tens of thousands of people, and makes sure customers get what they want when promised. The Innovation Lab at BLR8 pilots and proves new automation solutions, such as Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), automated packing equipment and internally developed tools, before they scale across this network.

The Innovation Lab is looking for a passionate, results-oriented Business Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment. The selected candidate will build and maintain the data platform, tools and reporting that tell us whether each pilot is working. They will also dig into the data to find the root cause of defects and give the team the evidence it needs to decide which solutions scale. The BA will also support hands-on pilot execution on the floor when required.

Key job responsibilities

Build the data foundation for every trial: write the SQL queries and extracts that pull pilot data from operational systems
Design and maintain dashboards that show each trial's progress against its success criteria
Set up alerts and exception reports that flag when a trial metric moves off target, so the team can act the same day
Monitor the health of DWP jobs, dashboards and data sources, and keep them reliable (target: 100% availability)
Find and fix the root cause of data issues and trouble tickets (failed jobs, missing or mismatched data)
Define the data plan for each pilot (metrics, baseline, collection method) before the trial starts
Own the lab scorecard and daily pilot report, and prepare the data for weekly business reviews and leadership updates
Analyse dashboard and alert trends to find the root cause of defects and underperformance, and propose specific actions
Support site-readiness analysis when a solution moves to a new site
Run pilots on the floor to the agreed test plan
Collect physical data (time studies, downtime and fault logs) and keep the issue log up to date
Follow and enforce pilot-area safety controls, including pre-trial checks for automation zones

Basic Qualifications

1+ years of data analytics or automation experience
1+ years of capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar experience
Bachelor's degree
Knowledge of data pipelining and extraction using SQL
Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level
Experience with data mining tools like SQL, SAS, SPSS, or similar

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of SQL/Python/R, scripting, MS Excel, table joins, and aggregate analytical functions

jobs.title: Financial Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
¿Qué es Cobre y qué hacemos?

Cobre es la plataforma líder de pagos B2B instantáneos en América Latina. Resolvemos los desafíos más complejos del movimiento de dinero en la región mediante la construcción de infraestructura financiera avanzada que permite a las empresas mover fondos de manera más rápida, segura y eficiente.

Habilitamos pagos empresariales instantáneos—locales o internacionales, directos o vía API—todo desde una única plataforma.

Diseñada para fintechs, PSP, bancos y equipos financieros que exigen velocidad, control y eficiencia. Desde pagos en tiempo real hasta tesorería automatizada, convertimos procesos financieros complejos en experiencias sencillas.

Cobre es la primera plataforma en Colombia que permite a las empresas pagar tanto a beneficiarios bancarizados como no bancarizados dentro del mismo ciclo de pago y a través de una sola interfaz.

¡Estamos construyendo la infraestructura de pagos corporativos de América Latina!

Propósito del cargo

Analista de Operaciones – Mercado Cambiario:
Ejecutar, controlar y conciliar las operaciones de compra, venta y canalización de divisas de la entidad, asegurando el cumplimiento de la regulación cambiaria colombiana, la correcta transmisión de información a las autoridades.

Responsabilidades principales

Operación y procesamiento

Procesar y verificar operaciones de compra y venta de divisas, y operaciones de canalización de ingresos y egresos por operaciones de cambio obligatoriamente canalizables y de aquellas que se canalizan de manera voluntaria.
Validar la documentación soporte de cada operación (declaraciones de cambio, numerales cambiarios, soportes de importaciones, exportaciones, endeudamiento externo, inversiones, servicios, etc.).
Asignar y validar los numerales cambiarios y verificar la correcta diligencia de las declaraciones de cambio.
Gestionar la liquidación y el cumplimiento de operaciones en moneda legal y en divisas con corresponsales y contrapartes.

Control, conciliación y reportes

Realizar la conciliación diaria de posiciones, cuentas de compensación, cuentas con corresponsales y saldos contables.
Identificar, investigar y resolver partidas pendientes, diferencias y excepciones operativas.
Preparar y transmitir los reportes cambiarios requeridos por el Banco de la República, la DIAN y la Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia, dentro de los plazos establecidos.
Apoyar la generación de reportes de posición propia, posición propia de contado y demás informes regulatorios aplicables.

Cumplimiento y gestión de riesgos

Aplicar la normativa cambiaria vigente (Resolución Externa 1 de 2018 de la Junta Directiva del Banco de la República y sus modificaciones, Circular Reglamentaria Externa DCIP-83 y demás normas relacionadas).
Aplicar los controles del SARLAFT en la operación diaria: validación de contrapartes, alertas, operaciones inusuales y reporte oportuno al área de Cumplimiento.
Identificar y escalar oportunamente riesgos operativos, errores y eventos de riesgo, y participar en la implementación de planes de mejora.
Atender requerimientos de auditoría interna, revisoría fiscal y entes de supervisión.

Relación áreas internas

Atender consultas operativas de clientes y de las áreas comerciales sobre trámites cambiarios y documentación requerida, a través de los canales definidos.
Coordinar con Tesorería, Contabilidad, Cumplimiento, Tecnología y Comercial para asegurar el flujo correcto de las operaciones.
Documentar procesos y proponer mejoras de eficiencia y automatización.

Requisitos mínimos

Formación académica

Profesional en Administración de Empresas, Economía, Finanzas, Contaduría Pública, Ingeniería Industrial o carreras afines.

Experiencia

Mínimo 1 a 3 años en áreas de operaciones
de tesorería, mesa de dinero, back office o canalización de divisas.
Experiencia comprobable en entidades vigiladas por la Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (bancos, comisionistas de bolsa, compañías de financiamiento, sociedades de intermediación cambiaria y servicios financieros especiales, fintech reguladas, etc.).

Conocimientos técnicos indispensables

Régimen cambiario colombiano: operaciones de cambio, numerales cambiarios, declaraciones de cambio, canalización obligatoria y voluntaria, cuentas de compensación.
Funcionamiento de los IMC y obligaciones de reporte ante Banco de la República, DIAN y SFC.
Conocimiento del SARLAFT y de la gestión del riesgo operativo (SARO).
Productos y operaciones de comercio exterior y de pagos internacionales (giros, transferencias).

Conocimientos y habilidades deseables

Experiencia con sistemas transaccionales de tesorería y plataformas de pagos transfronterizos.
Inglés intermedio (lectura de documentos y comunicación con corresponsales).
Conocimientos en SQL, Power BI o herramientas de automatización (valorado).

Location: Atlanta and Alpharetta

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

About The Job

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The exceptional EY experience. It's yours to build.

EY focuses on high-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities.

The Opportunity

As a Cybersecurity - Business Analyst, you will play a key role in helping clients and internal teams translate business needs into actionable requirements and effective security solutions. You will work with stakeholders across enterprise functions to understand objectives, analyze current-state processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and support the delivery of initiatives that drive operational efficiency and business value. This role offers the opportunity to contribute across the process lifecycles — from discovery and analysis through documentation, testing support, and implementation — while building strong partnerships across business and technical teams.

You will have the opportunity to lead the charge in supporting and enhancing our client's current-state processes and operating models. You will be at the forefront of creating and maintaining cutting-edge systems, working across departments to ensure alignment with business goals and technical requirements.

Your Key Responsibilities

Business Process Analysis: Document current business processes and workflows based on stakeholder interviews, documentation reviews, etc., identify improvement and optimization opportunities, and recommend changes and enhancements for future-state workflows.
Project Documentation: Complete required documentation to requirements across project phases and categories. Complete specific recommended or optional documents as needed.
Requirements Gathering: Plan and conduct stakeholder interviews, documenting requirements and user stories for in scope features, and analyze and prioritize requirements.
Business Impact Analysis: Evaluate operational, financial, and process implications of proposed changes, identify risks and dependencies, and support data driven decision making on business impacts.
Continuous Improvement: Gather stakeholder and user feedback to assess solution effectiveness, identify opportunities for continuous improvement, and lead continuous improvement efforts.
Data Analysis: As needed, analyze program health and performance data to identify trends and insights, create reports and dashboard using analyzed data, and validate data integrity and accuracy.
Testing Support: Support system integration testing and user acceptance testing (UAT) activities by developing test scenarios, coordinating defect resolution, validating business requirements, and partnering with stakeholders to ensure successful solution deployment.

To Qualify for the Role You Must Have

Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, finance, analytics, or a related field preferred
4-6+ years of experience in business analysis, process improvement, or related role
Experience gathering, documenting, and prioritizing business requirements,
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Experience with process mapping and documentation tools; familiarity with Agile/Scrum and/or SDLC methodologies
Proficiency in Excel or presentation/reporting tools and experience with PowerBI, SQL, Jira, or Visio preferred

Example
:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field preferred.
5-7 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure and security operations, with a focus on cloud platforms

What We Look For

We’re interested in intellectually curious people with a genuine passion for business analytics. With your experience, we’ll turn to you to speak up with innovative new ideas that could make a lasting difference not only to us but also to wider marketplace. If you have the confidence in both your presentation and technical abilities to grow into a leading expert here, this is the role for you.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job is:
New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $73,100 to $109,200
Bay Area California offices – $75,400 to $113,500
All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $61,200 to $100,500

Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

All in to shape the future with confidence.

About The Department

The Center for Translational Data Science (CTDS) at the University of Chicago is a research center whose mission is to develop the discipline of translational data science to impactful problems in biology, medicine, healthcare, and the environment. We envision a world in which researchers have ready access to the data needed and the tools required to make data driven discoveries that increase our scientific knowledge and improve the quality of life. We architect ecosystems of large-scale commons of research data, computing resources, applications, tools, and services for the broader research community to use data at scale to pursue scientific inquiry and accelerate discovery. Learn more at https://gdc.cancer.gov/, https://gen3.org/, https://stats.gen3.org/, and https://ctds.uchicago.edu/.

Job Summary

The Program Operations Analyst supports the development and operation of innovative biomedical data and software platforms that researchers rely on to advance cancer genomics. Reporting to the co-Principal Investigator and working in close partnership with the technical leads, the role contributes to planning, delivery, and communication across scientific, engineering, and operational teams, and serves as a point of contact for external partners.

Day to day, this position involves helping shape project and roadmap plans, identifying dependencies and risks, and keeping data and software releases on track. It also includes bringing the right people together and turning information into clear reports and proposals, in coordination with the Center's business operations and finance teams where needed. The Program Operations Analyst collaborates with the team to think through open questions and help develop practical solutions. Along the way, the Program Operations Analyst will gain familiarity with the software development lifecycle, data center infrastructure management, cancer genomics, and how shared data accelerates research.

jobs.description:
How to Apply

A cover letter and resume are required for consideration for this position; include the cover letter as the first page of your application. The letter should specifically address your interest in this position and outline relevant skills and experience.

Job Summary

The Demography of Aging, Disability and Care Program (DADC) in the Survey Research Center at the Institute for Social Research (ISR) conducts research focused on the consequences of population aging. The program provides leadership for several research projects including the National Health and Aging Trends Study (NHATS) and the National Study of Caregiving (NSOC).

We are seeking a full-time social science data analyst intermediate to collaborate with DADC research faculty to conduct analyses related to population aging, disability and care. The successful candidate will specialize in quantitative social science and have experience working with population-based aging-related surveys, like the National Health and Aging Trends Study (NHATS) and the National Study of Caregiving (NSOC) or similar national surveys.

This is a two-year term limited position with the possibility of extension. An extension will be based on available funding and performance. This position will report to the DADC program director.

Responsibilities*

The job functions of this role will include, but are not limited to:

35% Preparing survey data and creating analytic files

Writing programs to clean, recode and handle missing survey data using statistical packages such as Stata or R.
Prepare and organizes data files for statistical analysis.

35% Performing statistical analyses

Uses a variety of statistical methods and models. Selects and runs statistical tests in consultation with research faculty. Includes weighted analysis of descriptive data and model estimation, including generalized linear models (e.g., linear, logistic, and count regression), survival analyses, and mixed models. Advanced techniques like machine learning methods that may require deeper knowledge of R or Python are also of interest.

30% Documenting procedures and preparing methodological and technical materials

Clearly documents decisions including analytic file construction, variable generation, and model estimation.
Collaborate with research faculty to contribute technical material to publications and presentations. May include descriptions of data and methods, including design decisions, sample size justification, and analytic approach, and well-notated tables and figures.

Required Qualifications*

Master's degree in social science or public health field (e.g., epidemiology, quantitative sociology, demography, health services), or related field.
2-3 years of relevant work experience with complex, population-based surveys including demonstrated data management skills and experience preparing data for analysis and solid grounding in statistical theory and application to social sciences.
Highly motivated, organized, detail-oriented person with excellent multi-tasking ability and record-keeping.
Must be able to program, manage data, and conduct statistical analyses using statistical software packages such as Stata or R.
Willingness to learn and apply new methods and approaches.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, including ability to document complex data management and statistical work and excellent interpersonal skills.

Desired Qualifications*

Experience with the National Health and Aging Trends Study (NHATS) and National Study of Caregiving (NSOC)
Demonstrated interest in aging, health, caregiving or long-term care research.
Experience working with interdisciplinary research teams.

Modes of Work

Positions that are eligible for hybrid or mobile/remote work mode are at the discretion of the hiring department. Work agreements are reviewed annually at a minimum and are subject to change at any time, and for any reason, throughout the course of employment. Learn more about the work modes.

Work Locations

Work location is expected to be onsite in Ann Arbor with flexibility for hybrid work within our overall Center guidelines.

Additional Information

The Institute for Social Research (ISR) at the University of Michigan seeks to create a community of respect and authentic collaboration by recruiting and retaining individuals that represent a variety of voices as a reflection of our commitment to serve the people of Michigan, to maintain the excellence of the university, and to ground our research in varied disciplines, perspectives, and ways of knowing and learning.

Benefits At The University Of Michigan

In addition to a career filled with purpose and opportunity, U-M offers a comprehensive benefits package to help you stay well, protect yourself and your family, and plan for a secure future. Benefits include generous time off; retirement plan with two-for-one matching contributions after the first year; many choices for comprehensive health insurance; life insurance; long-term disability coverage; and flexible spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care expenses. About the Company

Vantage Group Holdings Ltd. (Vantage) was established in late 2020 as a re/insurance partner designed for the future. Driven by relentless curiosity, our team of trusted experts provides a fresh perspective on our clients’ risks. We add creativity to tech-enabled efficiency and robust analytics to address risks others avoid. Vantage provides specialty re/insurance through its operating subsidiaries in Bermuda and the U.S.

Vantage has approximately 365 colleagues in both the United States and Bermuda. We have offices in Chicago, IL, Norwalk, CT, West Hartford, CT, Washington, D.C., Boston, MA, New York, NY, Atlanta, GA, and Hamilton, Bermuda. Additionally, we are a highly geographically diverse workforce with colleagues based in 35 states and counting. We fully support work flexibility including remote and hybrid work arrangements.

Role location
: U.S.

About the role
:

The Senior Financial Data Analyst supports data analysis efforts related to insurance systems development, including data conversions, data preparation, and the maintenance of reference data that supports downstream systems such as the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Oracle General Ledger, and Ceded Reinsurance platforms.

A key focus of this role is partnering with the Finance team throughout the financial close process. This includes validating that data from source systems is accurately reflected in the EDW, ensuring premium calculations are producing expected results, investigating variances, and resolving discrepancies before results are posted to the General Ledger. The role also supports financial reconciliations and helps finalize reporting outcomes.

In addition, the Senior Financial Data Analyst is responsible for documenting source-to-target reconciliations, tracking data variances through resolution, and supporting compliance with audit and SOX requirements.

This position manages a prioritized backlog of development requests and user stories, ensuring business requirements are clearly documented and accurately represent stakeholder needs. The analyst works closely with developers to clarify requirements, validate completed solutions, and obtain business approval before implementation.

The Senior Financial Data Analyst partners closely with the VP, Insurance Enterprise Data to prioritize initiatives across the organization and collaborates with the Project Manager to coordinate releases, communicate changes, and support successful deployment of enhancements into the production environment.

Base salary for the selected candidate will range from $150,000 to $175,000, commensurate with candidate experience and expectations. Additionally, Vantage offers its colleagues performance-based bonus potential, strong health & welfare benefits, retirement plan, competitive time off plans, a highly flexible work environment, and much more.

Responsibilities & Accountabilities
:

Supports the VP of Insurance Enterprise Data to ensure effective and timely development of new and/or enhanced systems/technologies.
Provides deep technical and business analysis of data such that developers can effectively create solutions that assist leaders with data-driven decision making.
Creates source-to-target mappings with support from functional business representatives.
Owns the process of user and technical story writing for all work to be delivered.  
Maintains a groomed backlog, ensuring each story includes a clear, concise description, acceptance criteria, a developer point estimate, and an agreed-upon delivery expectation with the business.
Owns the process of obtaining business sign off on all stories being deployed to production as well as ensuring the code is released to production on a timely basis. This requires close consultation with developers to ensure proper evidence and documentation support the release.
Completes the business analysis activities and helps the development team understand the analysis.
Supports quality assurance efforts for assigned systems/technologies through vendors, system integrators, and internal development teams.
Design test cases and testing scenarios working with QA engineers.

Ideal Candidate Profile
:

Bachelor’s degree preferred, or an equivalent combination of professional experience.
5-7 years of experience in data analysis, business analysis, or financial systems support, ideally within the P&C insurance or reinsurance industry.
Experience working with data warehouses, general ledger systems, and financial close processes is preferred.
Strong knowledge of Property and Casualty Insurance, including policy life cycle, policy structure, and core data elements typically captured.
Experience working with financial data, particularly data feeding the General Ledger and supporting internal and external financial reporting.
Exposure to the audit process in providing evidence and support for financial controls.
Thorough understanding of Unearned Premium logic and derivation (including DAC).  Experience with validating and correcting logic used for the calculation.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge finance, IT, and development teams.  Must be comfortable speaking with and presenting to senior business leaders with respect to data solutions and challenges.
Basic SQL skills and the ability to read and understand ETL code and logic.
Sharp analytical skills – ability to triage data issues and recommend corrective action.
Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Experience with various data architectures (ODS, Data Lake, Data Marts, etc.).
Keen understanding of data transformations using Reference/Master data.
Exposure to cloud implementations using structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data methods.
Knowledge of application deployment & test automation products, processes, and best practices to ensure full source-to-target reconciliation.
Good understanding of Agile development methods and their application to company technology needs.

– be a force for good, for our customers, shareholders, colleagues, industry and communities.

– ask questions, listen to understand, challenge the status quo, look for ways to say YES, drive innovation, be opportunistic and disciplined.

jobs.description:

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Peripheral Vascular Health (PVH) is a dynamic business with annual revenue exceeding $1 billion across multiple high-growth therapy areas. PVH focuses on diagnosing and treating diseases of the peripheral arteries and veins, helping patients restore blood flow and reduce the risk of limb loss and other serious complications. The portfolio includes minimally invasive technologies such as drug-coated balloons, stents, atherectomy, thrombectomy, embolization, vein ablation, and embolic protection, designed to address complex peripheral vascular disease across a range of patient anatomies. By combining innovation, clinical evidence, and physician partnership, PVH aims to improve procedural outcomes and quality of life for patients worldwide.

At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. This position is remote to enhance our competitive edge and expand our cross-functional collaboration efforts. This role will require 10% of travel to enhance collaboration and ensure successful completion of projects.

The Senior Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR) Analyst
will be a critical contributor on the Cardiovascular HEOR team. The Senior HEOR Analyst is responsible for providing analytical and methodological expertise to support the development and execution of global health economic and outcomes evidence for Cardiovascular products, with an emphasis on the Peripheral Vascular Health portfolio. This position may be called upon to support multiple therapies, with a specific focus area on leading the execution of studies using administrative data to generate regulatory-grade evidence.

Role and Responsibilities:

Designs and conducts studies using administrative health care claims data and device-derived data to assess outcomes, health services utilization, treatment patterns and costs associated with the use of PVH therapies. Analysis may be used to support evidence development, federal and global agency (FDA, CMS, EU MDD/MDR) requests, clinical trial design, and reimbursement market trends.
Designs and conducts observational and economic research studies that provide value, perspective and evidence for clinical and/or pre-clinical product portfolio decisions, marketing, regulatory agency submissions, and product reimbursement strategies.
Compares and evaluates the value of products and therapies with the clinical, economic, and quality of life outcomes data from clinical trials and/or epidemiology studies, registries, observational studies, modeling, surveys, and meta-analysis.
Prepare observational and economic research study results for dissemination via abstract, presentation, and/or peer-reviewed publication.
Develops country specific evidence to meet requirements for optimal reimbursement coverage and usage.
Works closely with Reimbursement staff to determine the global economic evidence needs and potential impact of evidence on therapy coverage, payment, and adoption.
Works with clinical research to add relevant health outcomes and economic endpoints to clinical trials and biostatisticians to analyze and report study results.

Baccalaureate degree

Nice To Have

Advanced degree in health policy, health services research, health economics, epidemiology, or related field of study
Experience working with administrative claims data
Experience designing, modifying, or implementing decision analysis models (i.e., cost-effectiveness, budget impact)
Experience working with large databases including health care claims, administrative, or patient discharge data as a health service researcher, epidemiologist, data programmer or economist
Proficiency programming using statistical software (e.g. SAS, STATA, R, etc.)
Demonstrated competency in database file manipulation, data analysis and graphical presentation
Strong quantitative skills, preferably with training in econometrics or statistics
An understanding of health insurance and the U.S. health care system
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, especially the ability to communicate complex analytical techniques in a way that is understandable by non-quantitative audiences
Experience in the development of regulatory-grade analysis, synthesis, and presentation of complex data from multiple sources
Project management experience; demonstrated consultative mindset
Proven ability to work effectively in a highly matrixed organization
Proven relationship-building and maintaining skills with internal and external stakeholders including physician customers, hospital administrators or payers

214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

3+ years of experience in product management, data and analytics, business analysis, consulting, strategy, or a related field within the insurance industry.
Demonstrated knowledge of underwriting, actuarial, rate/product, portfolio, or underwriting operations processes.
Experience identifying business problems, shaping opportunities, and delivering insurance data solutions that support underwriting decisions, pricing analysis, portfolio insight, or operational execution.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect data capabilities to underwriting, actuarial, product, pricing, portfolio, or operational outcomes.
Experience leading cross-functional teams through ambiguity, aligning stakeholders, and influencing without direct authority.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced SQL skills, including data profiling, joins, aggregations, reconciliations, validation, issue investigation, and analysis across complex data sets.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and communication skills across business and technical audiences.

Bachelor’s degree in data science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Insurance, or a related field preferred.

Qui sommes-nous

Slalom est une entreprise de services-conseils en affaires et en technologies profondément humaine, axée sur les résultats et la collaboration avec les leaders afin de créer davantage de valeur ensemble. Notre mission est d’aider les personnes et les organisations à voir plus grand, avancer plus vite et bâtir un avenir meilleur pour tous. Chaque jour, nous mettons à profit notre expertise et notre passion pour agir comme conseiller de confiance, partenaire constructif et défenseur engagé auprès de chacun de nos clients.
Notre vision stratégique est d’être la première entreprise de notre industrie à créer davantage de valeur tout en générant des résultats concrets, dans le but de devenir l’entreprise de services la plus centrée sur ses clients et la plus habilitante pour ses employés au monde. De la stratégie à la mise en œuvre, nos équipes agiles réparties dans 52 bureaux à travers 12 pays collaborent avec nos clients pour concevoir des expériences client exceptionnelles, moderniser les modes de travail et générer un impact significatif.
Qu’est-ce qui nous distingue? Nous croyons que le travail doit être stimulant et valorisant, non pas parfait, mais réalisable. C’est pourquoi nous accordons une grande importance au sens, à la flexibilité, aux liens humains et à la reconnaissance, afin que nos employés puissent s’épanouir et aimer ce qu’ils font, la plupart du temps.
Ce que vous ferez

Diriger la planification et l’exécution d’initiatives complexes d’envergure comportant plusieurs volets de travail et couvrant divers domaines, notamment les programmes de modernisation (données, infonuagique, intelligence artificielle).
Transformer des enjeux stratégiques à fort impact et parfois ambiguës en stratégies de livraison structurées, modèles opérationnels et plans d’exécution.
Gérer des équipes multidisciplinaires regroupant des intervenants d’affaires, produits, technologies, opérations, fournisseurs et direction exécutive.
Diriger simultanément plusieurs projets complexes, portefeuilles de projets ou programmes de transformation à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
Collaborer avec des dirigeants clients afin de définir des indicateurs de succès, des cadres décisionnels et des modes de fonctionnement évolutifs.
Gérer les interdépendances, les risques et les contraintes tout en facilitant la priorisation, les arbitrages et les décisions de livraison.
Assurer la gestion financière des projets, incluant l’élaboration des budgets, les prévisions et la planification des ressources.
Mettre en place et faire évoluer les structures de gouvernance, les processus et les standards de livraison afin d’assurer des résultats cohérents et de haute qualité.
Adapter et appliquer différentes méthodologies de livraison (Agile, Cascade/Waterfall ou hybride) selon le contexte du client et le niveau de maturité organisationnelle.
Développer des solutions d’intelligence artificielle et intégrer des outils de gestion de projet alimentés par l’IA (p. ex. Jira, Microsoft Project, Planner, Smartsheet) pour soutenir la planification, la gestion des carnets de produits, la production de rapports et la prise de décision.
Agir comme mentor auprès des équipes, influencer les parties prenantes et favoriser l’alignement organisationnel.

Ce que vous apporterez

Plus de 8 ans d’expérience en consultation, à la direction de projets technologiques et d’initiatives de transformation organisationnelle dans des rôles tels que gestionnaire principal(e) de projets, gestionnaire de programme, analyste d’affaires principal(e) ou responsable de la livraison.
Excellente maîtrise des méthodologies Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Cascade (Waterfall) et hybrides.
Solide compréhension des concepts liés à l’intelligence artificielle ainsi qu’une expérience concrète dans le cadre d’initiatives impliquant l’IA, l’automatisation intelligente, l’apprentissage automatique (machine learning), l’analytique avancée ou les plateformes de transformation numérique.
Compréhension approfondie du cycle de vie complet des projets et du développement logiciel, de l’élaboration du dossier d’affaires jusqu’au déploiement et à la transition opérationnelle.
Excellente base technique et connaissance des applications d’entreprise, technologies infonuagiques, intégrations et infrastructures TI.
Aisance avec les pratiques modernes de génie logiciel, notamment l’utilisation d’outils de développement assistés par l’IA (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/Copilot), Visual Studio Code, GitHub, les processus de gestion du code source ainsi que les concepts CI/CD.
Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent; certifications telles que CSM, PMP, CBAP ou SAFe fortement souhaitées.

À propos de nous

Slalom est une entreprise de consultation en affaires et en technologies profondément humaine, axée sur les résultats afin de créer davantage de valeur, de toutes les façons, en tout temps. De la stratégie à la réalisation, nos équipes agiles réparties dans 52 bureaux dans 12 pays collaborent avec leurs clients pour concevoir des expériences client puissantes, de nouvelles façons de travailler et un impact durable.
Qu’est-ce qui nous distingue? Nous croyons que le travail doit être stimulant et gratifiant, non pas parfait, mais possible. C’est pourquoi nous privilégions le sens, la flexibilité, les connexions humaines et la reconnaissance afin que nos employés puissent s’épanouir et aimer ce qu’ils font, la plupart du temps.

Mode de travail hybride

Nous adoptons un modèle de travail hybride. Toutefois, les employés doivent être en mesure de se présenter sur site lorsque leur responsable ou leur client l’exige afin de répondre aux besoins de l’équipe ou du mandat.

Rémunération

Slalom s’engage à appliquer des pratiques de rémunération justes et équitables.
Pour ce poste, le salaire annuel de base prévu se situe entre 109 000 $ et 125 000 $
. Une prime discrétionnaire pouvant atteindre 10 %
du salaire de base peut également être offerte selon la performance individuelle et celle de l’entreprise.
La rémunération réelle sera établie en fonction des compétences, de l’expérience, des qualifications et d’autres facteurs pertinents.

Avantages offerts aux employés de Slalom

Culture et bien-être

Une culture dynamique et agréable
Séances « Lunch & Learn »
Activités santé et mieux-être
Fêtes de fin d’année et événements d’entreprise
Groupes-ressources pour les employés
Clubs sociaux et activités communautaires
Vacances (20 jours, au prorata selon la date d’embauche) ainsi que des journées de mieux-être et de maladie

Avantages concrets

Régime de rémunération concurrentiel
Remboursement mensuel de 100 $ pour le téléphone cellulaire
Régime enregistré d’épargne-retraite (REER) avec cotisation de contrepartie de l’employeur
Compte d’épargne libre d’impôt (CELI)
Carte-cadeau annuelle « Thrive Well-Being »
Programme de soutien à la planification familiale et à la fertilité
Bonification du congé de maternité et du congé parental
Assurance médicale et dentaire
Assurance vie et assurance décès ou mutilation accidentels (DMA)
Accès à une assurance vie et DMA complémentaire
Programme d’aide aux employés (PAE) et accès aux services de thérapie Inkblot
Et bien plus encore!

Tous les avantages sont soumis aux critères d’admissibilité applicables.
Équité, diversité et inclusion

Slalom est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances et s’engage à bâtir une main-d’œuvre diversifiée et inclusive. Nous encourageons les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées et nous nous engageons à fournir des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables à toutes les étapes du processus de recrutement et de sélection.
Veuillez informer l’équipe d’acquisition de talents si vous avez besoin d’une mesure d’adaptation pendant le processus d’entrevue.
Vérification des antécédents

Veuillez noter que toute personne embauchée chez Slalom devra se soumettre avec succès à une vérification des antécédents.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Who You’ll Work With

At Slalom, our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We are the connective tissue across all capabilities—bringing strategy to life through execution that is rigorous, adaptive, and outcome-driven.
You’ll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about making things happen. Our teams lead high-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it’s a multi-workstream transformation or a product launch, we bring clarity, structure, and momentum to every engagement.
We work shoulder-to-shoulder with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are—whether Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows.
So, What Will I Do?

Lead the planning and execution of large, complex, multi-workstream initiatives across different domains - i.e. modernization initiatives (data, cloud, AI).
Translate ambiguous, high-impact challenges into structured delivery strategies, operating models, and execution plans.
Manage cross-functional teams including business, product, technology, operations, vendors, and executive stakeholders.

Partner with senior client leaders to define success metrics, decision frameworks, and scalable ways of working.
Manage interdependencies, risks, and constraints while driving prioritization, trade-offs, and delivery decisions.
Manage project financials including budgeting, forecasting, and resource planning.
Establish and scale governance, processes, and delivery standards to enable consistent, high-quality outcomes.
Apply and scale delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid) based on client context and organizational maturity.
Develop AI solutions and incorporate AI-enabled delivery tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Planner, Smartsheet) to support planning, backlog management, reporting, and decision-making.
Mentor teams, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational alignment.

And, What Will I Bring

8+ years of consulting experience leading technology projects and business transformation initiatives in roles such as Senior Project Manager, Program Manager, Senior Business Analyst, or Delivery Lead.
Advanced knowledge of Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
Strong understanding of AI concepts and hands-on experience supporting initiatives involving AI-enabled solutions, intelligent automation, machine learning, advanced analytics, or digital transformation platforms.
Deep understanding of the end-to-end project and software development lifecycle - from business case development through planning, execution, deployment, and operational transition.

Technical fluency with modern software engineering practices, including familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/Copilot), Visual Studio Code, GitHub, source control workflows, and CI/CD concepts.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field; certifications such as CSM, PMP, CBAP, scaled agile preferred.

jobs.title: Customer Program Manager, Executive Briefings
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's Executive Briefing program brings senior leaders from our most strategic customers together with our spokespeople, product leaders, and researchers. As a Program Manager, Executive Briefings, you will run the program at one of our briefing centers and help build the global operating model that ensures an exceptional and consistent experience across the globe.

You will be the main program lead for your location and own briefings end to end: qualification and intake, agenda design, speaker selection, and day-of execution. You will set the objectives and design for each agenda and develop it jointly with Sales. You will also be the local account teams' go-to partner on how to use a briefing to move their most important opportunities forward.

You will manage the global workstream and set the standard every center follows, so customers get the same quality of briefing wherever they meet us. This is a highly cross-functional role. You will work with regional GTM leadership and the Office of the CCO on account selection and program strategy, with Product Marketing on content, with Solutions on technical deep-dives and demos, with Anthropic's executive bench on sponsorship and participation, and with Workplace, Security, and Revenue Operations on the experience and systems behind every briefing. You will be comfortable running every part of a briefing yourself and maintaining tight alignment with internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Executive Briefing program at your location: the local calendar, capacity planning, the request and intake process from Sales, and operating SLAs, applied against global criteria and regional allocation
Work with regional GTM leadership to decide which strategic accounts receive a briefing each quarter, hold the qualification bar, and proactively surface accounts that should be engaged
Lead discovery with account teams before each briefing to understand the customer's objectives, business context, and stage of evaluation, and turn that into a tailored agenda
Own agenda design and co-own agenda development with Sales for every briefing, including the narrative arc, discussion topics, speakers, and demos
Build and manage the speaker bench for your location: identify, source, and match speakers to briefings, run prep, and manage capacity so no one is over-asked
Own day-of orchestration and the customer experience standard at your center, in partnership with Workplace on logistics
Contribute to the playbooks, tooling, and best practices that let the program scale consistently across centers while allowing for regional nuance
Share intake and triage on a rotation across time zones so every request gets a decision within the defined SLA
Maintain one source of truth for criteria, lead times, and process so account teams get one answer
Own measurement and reporting for your center and contribute to global reporting on briefing volume, capacity and allocation, strategic-account coverage, and program-influenced pipeline and expansion
Onboard and coach briefing team members and contractors across locations

Minimum Qualifications

Experience running executive briefings, customer events, or a comparable program for senior external audiences
Program management skills, including intake and prioritization, capacity planning, and managing multiple concurrent programs against SLAs
Experience designing agendas and facilitating discussions with C-level or other senior customer audiences
Experience building processes, playbooks, or tooling that help a program operate consistently
Ability to track, report on, and communicate program metrics such as volume, coverage, and pipeline influence
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to partner credibly with field leadership, executives, and internal subject matter experts
Work on site at your briefing center when briefings take place

Preferred Qualifications

6+ years of experience building or scaling an executive briefing program, or a similar customer-facing program, at an enterprise technology company
Experience in a high-volume briefing environment
Experience with CRM and reporting tools such as Salesforce, and with connecting program activity to pipeline and expansion outcomes
Experience identifying and surfacing speakers for the speaker bench and managing speaker capacity across product, research, and executive teams
Experience working across time zones or across multiple sites to set one global standard
Experience onboarding or coaching new team members or contractors
Familiarity with AI products and how enterprises evaluate and adopt them
Interest in Anthropic's mission to build AI that is safe and beneficial

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$255,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. new_jobs.title: Sr Project Manager, Implementations
new_jobs.description:
Jeppesen ForeFlight is redefining the future of aviation technology, equipping pilots, operators, and decision-makers with the software tools to forge bold new digital paths that push past the expected. We stand with those who dream bigger, fly farther, and seek to explore the next frontier in the cockpit and operations center.

Jeppesen ForeFlight is seeking a Senior Project Manager, Implementations reporting to the Senior Manager, Professional Services Implementation & Deployment, to lead complex, customer-facing implementation and migration projects across our legacy and next-generation flight planning products, including our JetPlan Engine platform migration program moving customers off unsupported legacy hardware and operating systems onto current, supported infrastructure.

As a Senior Project Manager, you will own the end-to-end planning, scheduling, and delivery of multi-workstream implementation and migration projects, coordinating across Development, Deployment Specialists, Quality Assurance, and the customer's own technical team to move complex, production flight-planning systems safely from legacy infrastructure onto our current platforms.

A successful candidate is comfortable being the connective tissue across engineering, deployment, and the customer on a technically complex, high-stakes project, tracking schedule, risk, and dependencies with equal rigor. You're equally comfortable running a detailed cutover plan, presenting a clear status update to executive stakeholders, and keeping several concurrent migrations on track at once. You either know legacy-to-modern infrastructure migrations already, or you're eager to learn the space quickly.

Key Responsibilities

Own project planning, scheduling, and status reporting for one or more complex implementation and migration projects, from kickoff through go-live and into early production support handoff
Build and maintain detailed project plans, RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), and cutover/go-live runbooks for each migration
Coordinate across Development, Deployment Specialists, Quality Assurance, and Support to sequence and de-risk cutover activities for production systems that cannot tolerate extended downtime
Manage and track project status in Salesforce, keeping stakeholders and leadership current on schedule, risk, and blockers
Lead recurring customer- and internal-facing status meetings, translating technical migration details into clear, actionable updates for both technical and executive stakeholders
Coordinate go-live/cutover events directly with customer technical teams, including scheduling maintenance windows and validating post-cutover system health
Identify and escalate schedule, resource, or technical risks early, and drive mitigation plans to closure
Support post-go-live stabilization and a clean handoff to ongoing support
Partner with Product, Support, and other internal teams to resolve issues and escalations surfaced during a migration
Travel to customer sites on occasion, as needed

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of project management experience delivering complex, technical implementation or migration projects, ideally including production system cutovers
Experience managing multi-stakeholder projects spanning internal engineering/deployment teams and external customer technical teams
Strong technical aptitude, comfortable understanding infrastructure migration concepts (e.g., legacy operating system to Linux platform migrations) well enough to plan and sequence around them, without requiring a software engineering background
Experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM/project-tracking tool
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting project status to both technical teams and executive stakeholders
Strong critical thinking and risk-management skills, with the ability to identify and mitigate schedule and technical risk before it becomes a problem
Willingness to learn and apply AI-powered tools to accelerate project tracking, status reporting, and cross-team coordination; prior hands-on experience with AI tools is a plus
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize independently

Preferred Qualifications

PMP or a comparable project management certification
Experience in airline operations, flight dispatch, or aviation technology
Experience coordinating international, multi-time-zone customer implementations
Background in client or account management, with the ability to translate customer needs into a project plan
Comfort working across time zones with international customers

About Jeppesen ForeFlight

Jeppesen ForeFlight is a leading provider of innovative aviation software solutions, serving the Commercial, Business, Military, and General Aviation sectors globally. Combining Jeppesen’s 90-year legacy of accurate aeronautical data with ForeFlight’s expertise in cutting-edge aviation technology, the company delivers an integrated suite of tools designed to enhance safety, improve operational efficiency, and sharpen decision-making.

Why You Should Join

At Jeppesen ForeFlight, we know you want a rewarding career. To do that, you need challenging projects, a good work environment, and awesome coworkers. We believe in our employees, and we empower them to make a direct impact on our products and services messaging. We strive to provide our team and their loved ones with a world-class benefits experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Position:

Project Manager

Position Location:

Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Salary

QC Servion recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

QC Servion is seeking a Project Manager to support large-scale infrastructure and data center programs across the QC Ecosystem. This role is responsible for owning individual projects and workstreams from kickoff through closeout while ensuring alignment with broader program objectives, schedules, and stakeholder expectations.

We are looking for a project leader with experience supporting engineering, construction, infrastructure, capital projects, data centers, or EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) environments.

The Project Manager will work closely with Program Managers, Project Controls, engineering teams, design partners, contractors, vendors, and ecosystem stakeholders to drive execution, maintain visibility into project performance, and proactively resolve issues before they impact delivery.

Essential Functions

Project Leadership & Execution

Own assigned projects and workstreams from initiation through closeout.
Develop and maintain project execution plans, schedules, and milestone tracking.
Drive project progress and accountability across internal teams, vendors, consultants, and external partners.
Coordinate project activities to ensure alignment with program objectives, timelines, and deliverables.
Facilitate project meetings, track action items, and follow through to completion.

Schedule & Program Integration

Build and maintain project-level schedules aligned to the broader program master schedule.
Monitor project dependencies and identify impacts to adjacent workstreams.
Support integration of project schedules into the overall program plan.
Escalate schedule risks and conflicts proactively while recommending mitigation strategies.

Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination

Coordinate activities across engineering, design, construction, infrastructure, and operational stakeholders.
Manage communication between project teams, vendors, consultants, and leadership.
Ensure all parties understand scope, responsibilities, milestones, and expectations.
Support cross-functional collaboration across the QC Ecosystem and external delivery partners.

Project Controls & Reporting

Track project budgets, scope, schedules, risks, issues, and progress.
Maintain accurate project documentation including meeting notes, decision logs, change requests, and status reports.
Provide regular project updates and executive-ready reporting to Program Leadership.
Contribute to phase-gate reviews and readiness assessments.

Identify project-level risks, constraints, and issues early.
Drive resolution through collaboration and ownership.
Develop mitigation plans and corrective actions when needed.
Escalate issues appropriately while ensuring accountability remains clear.

Projects remain aligned with program milestones and strategic objectives.
Risks and issues are identified and resolved before impacting delivery.
Stakeholders have clear visibility into project status, priorities, and next steps.
Documentation and reporting are accurate, current, and decision-ready.
Engineering, design, vendors, and project teams remain coordinated and accountable.
Workstreams are delivered on schedule, within scope, and with minimal leadership intervention.

Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, vendors, consultants, and technical teams.
Strong understanding of project scheduling, dependencies, risk management, and project execution.
Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience maintaining project documentation and status reporting.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.

Data center development, construction, commissioning, or infrastructure experience.
Experience within EPC, engineering consulting, owner’s representative, or capital project delivery environments.
Exposure to large-scale infrastructure, mission-critical facilities, energy, utility, or industrial projects.
Experience supporting multiple projects within a larger program structure.
PMP or similar project management certification.

Duties

Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and professional licensing assistance.
