Qui sommes-nous

Slalom est une entreprise de services-conseils en affaires et en technologies profondément humaine, axée sur les résultats et la collaboration avec les leaders afin de créer davantage de valeur ensemble. Notre mission est d’aider les personnes et les organisations à voir plus grand, avancer plus vite et bâtir un avenir meilleur pour tous. Chaque jour, nous mettons à profit notre expertise et notre passion pour agir comme conseiller de confiance, partenaire constructif et défenseur engagé auprès de chacun de nos clients.
Notre vision stratégique est d’être la première entreprise de notre industrie à créer davantage de valeur tout en générant des résultats concrets, dans le but de devenir l’entreprise de services la plus centrée sur ses clients et la plus habilitante pour ses employés au monde. De la stratégie à la mise en œuvre, nos équipes agiles réparties dans 52 bureaux à travers 12 pays collaborent avec nos clients pour concevoir des expériences client exceptionnelles, moderniser les modes de travail et générer un impact significatif.
Qu’est-ce qui nous distingue? Nous croyons que le travail doit être stimulant et valorisant, non pas parfait, mais réalisable. C’est pourquoi nous accordons une grande importance au sens, à la flexibilité, aux liens humains et à la reconnaissance, afin que nos employés puissent s’épanouir et aimer ce qu’ils font, la plupart du temps.
Ce que vous ferez

Diriger la planification et l’exécution d’initiatives complexes d’envergure comportant plusieurs volets de travail et couvrant divers domaines, notamment les programmes de modernisation (données, infonuagique, intelligence artificielle).
Transformer des enjeux stratégiques à fort impact et parfois ambiguës en stratégies de livraison structurées, modèles opérationnels et plans d’exécution.
Gérer des équipes multidisciplinaires regroupant des intervenants d’affaires, produits, technologies, opérations, fournisseurs et direction exécutive.
Diriger simultanément plusieurs projets complexes, portefeuilles de projets ou programmes de transformation à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
Collaborer avec des dirigeants clients afin de définir des indicateurs de succès, des cadres décisionnels et des modes de fonctionnement évolutifs.
Gérer les interdépendances, les risques et les contraintes tout en facilitant la priorisation, les arbitrages et les décisions de livraison.
Assurer la gestion financière des projets, incluant l’élaboration des budgets, les prévisions et la planification des ressources.
Mettre en place et faire évoluer les structures de gouvernance, les processus et les standards de livraison afin d’assurer des résultats cohérents et de haute qualité.
Adapter et appliquer différentes méthodologies de livraison (Agile, Cascade/Waterfall ou hybride) selon le contexte du client et le niveau de maturité organisationnelle.
Développer des solutions d’intelligence artificielle et intégrer des outils de gestion de projet alimentés par l’IA (p. ex. Jira, Microsoft Project, Planner, Smartsheet) pour soutenir la planification, la gestion des carnets de produits, la production de rapports et la prise de décision.
Agir comme mentor auprès des équipes, influencer les parties prenantes et favoriser l’alignement organisationnel.

Ce que vous apporterez

Plus de 8 ans d’expérience en consultation, à la direction de projets technologiques et d’initiatives de transformation organisationnelle dans des rôles tels que gestionnaire principal(e) de projets, gestionnaire de programme, analyste d’affaires principal(e) ou responsable de la livraison.
Excellente maîtrise des méthodologies Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Cascade (Waterfall) et hybrides.
Solide compréhension des concepts liés à l’intelligence artificielle ainsi qu’une expérience concrète dans le cadre d’initiatives impliquant l’IA, l’automatisation intelligente, l’apprentissage automatique (machine learning), l’analytique avancée ou les plateformes de transformation numérique.
Compréhension approfondie du cycle de vie complet des projets et du développement logiciel, de l’élaboration du dossier d’affaires jusqu’au déploiement et à la transition opérationnelle.
Excellente base technique et connaissance des applications d’entreprise, technologies infonuagiques, intégrations et infrastructures TI.
Aisance avec les pratiques modernes de génie logiciel, notamment l’utilisation d’outils de développement assistés par l’IA (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/Copilot), Visual Studio Code, GitHub, les processus de gestion du code source ainsi que les concepts CI/CD.
Baccalauréat dans un domaine pertinent; certifications telles que CSM, PMP, CBAP ou SAFe fortement souhaitées.

À propos de nous

Slalom est une entreprise de consultation en affaires et en technologies profondément humaine, axée sur les résultats afin de créer davantage de valeur, de toutes les façons, en tout temps. De la stratégie à la réalisation, nos équipes agiles réparties dans 52 bureaux dans 12 pays collaborent avec leurs clients pour concevoir des expériences client puissantes, de nouvelles façons de travailler et un impact durable.
Qu’est-ce qui nous distingue? Nous croyons que le travail doit être stimulant et gratifiant, non pas parfait, mais possible. C’est pourquoi nous privilégions le sens, la flexibilité, les connexions humaines et la reconnaissance afin que nos employés puissent s’épanouir et aimer ce qu’ils font, la plupart du temps.

Mode de travail hybride

Nous adoptons un modèle de travail hybride. Toutefois, les employés doivent être en mesure de se présenter sur site lorsque leur responsable ou leur client l’exige afin de répondre aux besoins de l’équipe ou du mandat.

Rémunération

Slalom s’engage à appliquer des pratiques de rémunération justes et équitables.
Pour ce poste, le salaire annuel de base prévu se situe entre 109 000 $ et 125 000 $
. Une prime discrétionnaire pouvant atteindre 10 %
du salaire de base peut également être offerte selon la performance individuelle et celle de l’entreprise.
La rémunération réelle sera établie en fonction des compétences, de l’expérience, des qualifications et d’autres facteurs pertinents.

Avantages offerts aux employés de Slalom

Culture et bien-être

Une culture dynamique et agréable
Séances « Lunch & Learn »
Activités santé et mieux-être
Fêtes de fin d’année et événements d’entreprise
Groupes-ressources pour les employés
Clubs sociaux et activités communautaires
Vacances (20 jours, au prorata selon la date d’embauche) ainsi que des journées de mieux-être et de maladie

Avantages concrets

Régime de rémunération concurrentiel
Remboursement mensuel de 100 $ pour le téléphone cellulaire
Régime enregistré d’épargne-retraite (REER) avec cotisation de contrepartie de l’employeur
Compte d’épargne libre d’impôt (CELI)
Carte-cadeau annuelle « Thrive Well-Being »
Programme de soutien à la planification familiale et à la fertilité
Bonification du congé de maternité et du congé parental
Assurance médicale et dentaire
Assurance vie et assurance décès ou mutilation accidentels (DMA)
Accès à une assurance vie et DMA complémentaire
Programme d’aide aux employés (PAE) et accès aux services de thérapie Inkblot
Et bien plus encore!

Tous les avantages sont soumis aux critères d’admissibilité applicables.
Équité, diversité et inclusion

Slalom est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances et s’engage à bâtir une main-d’œuvre diversifiée et inclusive. Nous encourageons les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées et nous nous engageons à fournir des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables à toutes les étapes du processus de recrutement et de sélection.
Veuillez informer l’équipe d’acquisition de talents si vous avez besoin d’une mesure d’adaptation pendant le processus d’entrevue.
Vérification des antécédents

Veuillez noter que toute personne embauchée chez Slalom devra se soumettre avec succès à une vérification des antécédents.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Who You’ll Work With

At Slalom, our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We are the connective tissue across all capabilities—bringing strategy to life through execution that is rigorous, adaptive, and outcome-driven.
You’ll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about making things happen. Our teams lead high-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it’s a multi-workstream transformation or a product launch, we bring clarity, structure, and momentum to every engagement.
We work shoulder-to-shoulder with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are—whether Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows.
So, What Will I Do?

Lead the planning and execution of large, complex, multi-workstream initiatives across different domains - i.e. modernization initiatives (data, cloud, AI).
Translate ambiguous, high-impact challenges into structured delivery strategies, operating models, and execution plans.
Manage cross-functional teams including business, product, technology, operations, vendors, and executive stakeholders.
Lead multiple complex concurrent projects with multiple workstreams, project portfolios, or enterprise-wide transformation programs.
Partner with senior client leaders to define success metrics, decision frameworks, and scalable ways of working.
Manage interdependencies, risks, and constraints while driving prioritization, trade-offs, and delivery decisions.
Manage project financials including budgeting, forecasting, and resource planning.
Establish and scale governance, processes, and delivery standards to enable consistent, high-quality outcomes.
Apply and scale delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid) based on client context and organizational maturity.
Develop AI solutions and incorporate AI-enabled delivery tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Planner, Smartsheet) to support planning, backlog management, reporting, and decision-making.
Mentor teams, influence stakeholders, and drive organizational alignment.

And, What Will I Bring

8+ years of consulting experience leading technology projects and business transformation initiatives in roles such as Senior Project Manager, Program Manager, Senior Business Analyst, or Delivery Lead.
Advanced knowledge of Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
Strong understanding of AI concepts and hands-on experience supporting initiatives involving AI-enabled solutions, intelligent automation, machine learning, advanced analytics, or digital transformation platforms.
Deep understanding of the end-to-end project and software development lifecycle - from business case development through planning, execution, deployment, and operational transition.
Solid technical foundation with familiarity across enterprise applications, cloud technologies, integrations, and IT infrastructure.
Technical fluency with modern software engineering practices, including familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT/Copilot), Visual Studio Code, GitHub, source control workflows, and CI/CD concepts.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field; certifications such as CSM, PMP, CBAP, scaled agile preferred.

new_jobs.title: Customer Program Manager, Executive Briefings
new_jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic's Executive Briefing program brings senior leaders from our most strategic customers together with our spokespeople, product leaders, and researchers. As a Program Manager, Executive Briefings, you will run the program at one of our briefing centers and help build the global operating model that ensures an exceptional and consistent experience across the globe.

You will be the main program lead for your location and own briefings end to end: qualification and intake, agenda design, speaker selection, and day-of execution. You will set the objectives and design for each agenda and develop it jointly with Sales. You will also be the local account teams' go-to partner on how to use a briefing to move their most important opportunities forward.

You will manage the global workstream and set the standard every center follows, so customers get the same quality of briefing wherever they meet us. This is a highly cross-functional role. You will work with regional GTM leadership and the Office of the CCO on account selection and program strategy, with Product Marketing on content, with Solutions on technical deep-dives and demos, with Anthropic's executive bench on sponsorship and participation, and with Workplace, Security, and Revenue Operations on the experience and systems behind every briefing. You will be comfortable running every part of a briefing yourself and maintaining tight alignment with internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Executive Briefing program at your location: the local calendar, capacity planning, the request and intake process from Sales, and operating SLAs, applied against global criteria and regional allocation
Work with regional GTM leadership to decide which strategic accounts receive a briefing each quarter, hold the qualification bar, and proactively surface accounts that should be engaged
Lead discovery with account teams before each briefing to understand the customer's objectives, business context, and stage of evaluation, and turn that into a tailored agenda
Own agenda design and co-own agenda development with Sales for every briefing, including the narrative arc, discussion topics, speakers, and demos
Build and manage the speaker bench for your location: identify, source, and match speakers to briefings, run prep, and manage capacity so no one is over-asked
Own day-of orchestration and the customer experience standard at your center, in partnership with Workplace on logistics
Contribute to the playbooks, tooling, and best practices that let the program scale consistently across centers while allowing for regional nuance
Share intake and triage on a rotation across time zones so every request gets a decision within the defined SLA
Maintain one source of truth for criteria, lead times, and process so account teams get one answer
Own measurement and reporting for your center and contribute to global reporting on briefing volume, capacity and allocation, strategic-account coverage, and program-influenced pipeline and expansion
Onboard and coach briefing team members and contractors across locations

Minimum Qualifications

Experience running executive briefings, customer events, or a comparable program for senior external audiences
Program management skills, including intake and prioritization, capacity planning, and managing multiple concurrent programs against SLAs
Experience designing agendas and facilitating discussions with C-level or other senior customer audiences
Experience building processes, playbooks, or tooling that help a program operate consistently
Ability to track, report on, and communicate program metrics such as volume, coverage, and pipeline influence
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to partner credibly with field leadership, executives, and internal subject matter experts
Work on site at your briefing center when briefings take place

Preferred Qualifications

6+ years of experience building or scaling an executive briefing program, or a similar customer-facing program, at an enterprise technology company
Experience in a high-volume briefing environment
Experience with CRM and reporting tools such as Salesforce, and with connecting program activity to pipeline and expansion outcomes
Experience identifying and surfacing speakers for the speaker bench and managing speaker capacity across product, research, and executive teams
Experience working across time zones or across multiple sites to set one global standard
Experience onboarding or coaching new team members or contractors
Familiarity with AI products and how enterprises evaluate and adopt them
Interest in Anthropic's mission to build AI that is safe and beneficial

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$255,000—$320,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.
